**Why Charlie Health?**
 Millions of people across the country are navigating mental health conditions, substance use disorders, and eating disorders, but too often, they’re met with barriers to care. From limited local options and long wait times to treatment that lacks personalization, behavioral healthcare can leave people feeling unseen and unsupported.
   

  

 Charlie Health exists to change that. Our mission is to connect the world to life\-saving behavioral health treatment. We deliver personalized, virtual care rooted in connection—between clients and clinicians, care teams, loved ones, and the communities that support them. By focusing on people with complex needs, we’re expanding access to meaningful care and driving better outcomes from the comfort of home.
   

  

 As a rapidly growing organization, we're reaching more communities every day and building a team that’s redefining what behavioral health treatment can look like. If you're ready to use your skills to drive lasting change and help more people access the care they deserve, we’d love to meet you.
   

  

**About The Role**
 The next generation of behavioral health will be built on agentic AI — systems that don't just predict or summarize, but act: scheduling, coordinating care, drafting clinical documentation, surfacing risk, and orchestrating the hundreds of micro\-decisions that today consume clinician and operator time.
   

  

 Charlie Health's ambition is to build the most advanced agentic systems in healthcare. We are investing in a multi\-agent architecture grounded in a real\-time clinical signal graph, governed by HIPAA\-native infrastructure, and deployed against measurable patient outcomes in a national virtual IOP.
   

  

 We are hiring a Distinguished AI Engineer to lead the design, development, and deployment of these systems across our platform. This is a hands\-on technical leadership role with deep cross\-functional reach into Engineering, Product, Data, Clinical, and executive leadership.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Serve as the technical owner of agentic AI at Charlie Health, from architecture and model strategy through production deployment and ongoing reliability.
* Lead the development of clinical operations agents that handle scheduling, intake, insurance verification, referral triage, and care coordination, replacing brittle human handoffs with auditable, supervised AI workflows.
* Lead the development of clinician copilots for real\-time documentation, risk surfacing, and treatment\-plan support, integrated with our EHR and clinical data platform.
* Define and build the agentic substrate: eval frameworks, observability, guardrails, tool registries, prompt and policy versioning, PHI\-safe logging, and simulation environments.
* Own the model strategy across frontier models, fine\-tunes, distilled specialists, and classic ML, and articulate it clearly to executive and clinical leadership.
* Partner with Product, Clinical, and Data teams to identify high\-leverage opportunities for AI across patient and operational experiences.
* Establish best practices around AI reliability, safety, evaluation, and explainability in a regulated clinical environment.
* Mentor engineers and data scientists across the organization and help foster a strong culture of technical excellence and responsible AI innovation.


**What You'll Work With**
* An executive team that has committed to an AI\-native operating model and is funding it.
* An AI Guild of senior engineers, data scientists, and clinical operators piloting AI across the company today.
* A modern data foundation including Snowflake, dbt, pgvector, and an emerging Intelligence Layer that exposes patient and operational signals as first\-class events.
* Live workstreams in clinical documentation, referral\-source conversion modeling, scheduling intelligence, and clinician productivity.
* A national virtual IOP serving patients across 41 states, with the regulated data and outcome signal needed to train, evaluate, and improve real systems.


**Why this role is hard**
 Behavioral health is one of the most demanding applied\-AI environments. Patients are often in acute distress. The regulatory surface spans HIPAA, state\-by\-state telehealth and licensure law, and rising FDA scrutiny of clinical decision support. AI systems in this environment must be observable, reversible, and defensible to clinicians, to regulators, and to internal review.
   

  

 We are looking for an engineer who finds those constraints clarifying rather than limiting.
   

  

**Requirements**
* 10\+ years of software engineering experience, with several recent years focused on LLM\- or ML\-powered systems in production.
* Hands\-on experience designing and operating agentic systems, including tool use, planning, multi\-agent orchestration, eval design, and failure\-mode analysis.
* Track record of owning a complex technical initiative end\-to\-end, including evaluation infrastructure, observability, on\-call, and regulatory or compliance review.
* Strong communication skills and comfort operating across registers, from executive strategy conversations to engineering code review.
* Genuine interest in healthcare and in applying AI responsibly in a regulated, high\-stakes domain.
* BS, MS, or PhD in Computer Science, Machine Learning, Engineering, Mathematics, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.
* Able to work a hybrid schedule of 4 days/week in our NYC office and located within 75 minutes' commuting distance of the office

**Description**
 Amazon Web Services (AWS) is building a central pipeline of Software Development Engineer (SDE) talent for anticipated roles in 2026\. This requisition supports hiring across all AWS SDE positions, from fungible SDE roles to specialized engineering positions in areas including:
   

  

* Embedded Systems
* Game Development
* Compiler Engineering
* Artificial Intelligence/Machine Learning
* Healthcare AI
* Infrastructure Services
* Firmware Development
* Cloud Computing
* Distributed Systems
* Security Engineering
* Video Processing and Streaming
* Content Delivery Network (CDN)


 When you apply to this position, your profile will be considered for current and future SDE openings across AWS, including teams such as Twitch, AWS Elemental, and AWS CloudFront.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

**As An AWS Software Development Engineer, You Will**
* Design, develop, and maintain efficient, reusable, and reliable code
* Implement complex software solutions that meet business requirements
* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams to define, design, and ship new features
* Identify and resolve performance bottlenecks and bugs
* Participate in architecture and design reviews to provide technical guidance
* Contribute to continuous improvement by identifying opportunities for process enhancement
* Stay current with emerging technologies and industry trends
* Mentor junior engineers and contribute to building a strong engineering culture


 A day in the life
   

  

 On a typical day as an AWS SDE, you might:
   

  

* Start your morning with a team stand\-up to align on priorities and address any blockers
* Collaborate with product managers to refine requirements for upcoming features
* Write code and develop solutions for complex technical challenges
* Review pull requests from team members, providing constructive feedback
* Participate in design discussions for new services or features
* Debug and troubleshoot production issues as they arise
* Attend learning sessions to stay current with AWS technologies
* Document your work and contribute to technical specifications
* Engage with customers or internal stakeholders to better understand their needs


**About The Team**
 Our central SDE sourcing team specializes exclusively in the SDE job family across AWS. This team of experts understands the nuances of various SDE roles throughout the organization and serves as your dedicated resource throughout the hiring process. Here's what you can expect:
   

  

* An SDE sourcer will contact you for an initial screening call to understand your background, skills, and interests
* They will share specific details about what you need to succeed in the interview process
* As the right roles become available, your sourcer will stay in touch and connect you with appropriate teams
* Throughout the process, the central team will provide guidance and preparation support


**Basic Qualifications**
* 3\+ years of non\-internship professional software development experience
* 2\+ years of non\-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
* 3\+ years of building complex software systems experience
* 2\+ years of designing and developing large\-scale, multi\-tiered, multi\-threaded, embedded or distributed software applications, tools, systems, and services using: C\#, C\+\+, Java, or Perl experience
* Bachelor's degree or equivalent


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Knowledge of ML frameworks including JAX, PyTorch, vLLM, SGLang, Dynamo, TorchXLA, and TensorRT
* Knowledge of Machine Learning and LLM fundamentals, including transformer architecture, training/inference lifecycles, and optimization techniques
* Knowledge of Python and/or C\+\+ programming
